v.1: I swear by the Day of Resurrection!
v.2: And I swear by the self-critical soul!
v.3: Does man suppose that We will not put together his bones [at resurrection]?
v.4: Yes indeed, We are able to [re]shape [even] his fingertips!
v.5: Indeed, man desires to go on living viciously.
v.6: He asks, ‘When will be this “day of resurrection”?!’
v.7: But when the eyes are dazzled,
v.9: and the sun and the moon are brought together,
v.10: that day man will say, ‘Where is the escape [from this day]?’
v.11: No indeed! There will be no refuge!
v.12: That day the [final] goal will be toward your Lord.
v.13: That day man will be informed about what [works] he had sent ahead [to the scene of judgement] and [the legacy that he had] left behind.
v.14: Indeed, man is a witness to himself,
v.15: though he should offer excuses [to justify his failings].
v.16: Do not move your tongue with it to hasten it.
v.17: Indeed it is up to Us to put it together and to recite it.
v.18: And when We have recited it, follow its recitation.
v.19: Then, its exposition [also] lies with Us.
v.20: No! Indeed, you love this transitory life
v.22: Some faces will be fresh on that day,
v.24: and some faces will be scowling on that day,
v.25: knowing that they will be dealt out a punishment breaking the spine.
v.26: No indeed! When it reaches up to the collar bones
v.27: and it is said, ‘Who will take him up?’
v.28: and he knows that it is the [time of] parting,
v.29: and each shank clasps the other shank,
v.30: that day he shall be driven toward your Lord.
v.31: He neither confirmed [the messages of Allah], nor did he pray,
v.33: and went back swaggering to his family.
v.34: So, woe to you! Woe to you!
v.35: Again, woe to you! Woe to you!
v.36: Does man suppose that he has been abandoned to futility?
v.37: Was he not a drop of emitted semen,
v.38: and then a clinging mass? Whereat He created and proportioned [him],
v.39: and made of him the two sexes, male and female.
v.40: Is not [someone like] that able to revive the dead?
